metadata.description: Job Co-Pilot: a personal job-search operating system for Claude that knows the value you have delivered and helps you apply, interview, and network.

plugins.name: job-copilot
plugins.description: Turns Claude into a job-search co-pilot that knows your experience and the value you delivered, tailors applications from it, preps you for interviews, and keeps your network warm. Draft-only: nothing is sent on your behalf. Tool-agnostic: it adapts to your email, browser, and document tools at setup. Built on the structure of PM Co-Pilot by Daniel Blum.
